meaning:
θεατρίζω
(θέατρον),
to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt (eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., Heb.10:33.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: whilst ye were made a gazingstock

elsewhere.note: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
